name: LinkedIn
description: LinkedIn is a professional networking platform enabling job seekers, companies, and thought leaders to connect, share content, and discover business opportunities

tools.name: Create article or URL share
tools.description: Tool to create an article or URL share on LinkedIn using the UGC Posts API. Use when you need to share a link with optional commentary on LinkedIn. Supports sharing URLs as articles with customizable visibility settings.

inputs.name: author
inputs.about: URN of the author (person or organization). For a person: 'urn:li:person:{id}'. For an organization: 'urn:li:organization:{id}'. Use GET_MY_INFO action to get your person ID.

inputs.name: visibility
inputs.about: Visibility settings for the post. Controls who can see the shared content.

inputs.name: lifecycleState
inputs.about: State of the post. Use 'PUBLISHED' to post immediately or 'DRAFT' to save as draft.

inputs.name: specificContent
inputs.about: Container for the share content including URL, commentary, and media category.

tools.name: Create comment on LinkedIn post
tools.description: Tool to create a first-level or nested comment on a LinkedIn share, UGC post, or parent comment via the Social Actions Comments API. Use when you need to engage with posts by adding comments or replying to existing comments. Supports text comments with optional @-mentions and image attachments.

inputs.name: actor
inputs.about: Entity which authored the comment. For personal comments: 'urn:li:person:{id}'. For organization comments: 'urn:li:organization:{id}'. Use the GET_USER_INFO action to retrieve the 'id' field.

inputs.name: object
inputs.about: The URN of the share or ugcPost that contains the comment. Typically the same as target_urn for first-level comments, or the root post URN for nested comments. Must be 'urn:li:share:{id}' or 'urn:li:ugcPost:{id}'. Activity URNs ('urn:li:activity:{id}') are NOT supported.

inputs.name: content
inputs.about: Array of content entities such as images to include in the comment. Each entity should contain an image URN or other content type.

inputs.name: message
inputs.about: The comment message content including text and optional @-mentions.

inputs.name: target_urn
inputs.about: The URN of the share, UGC post, or parent comment where the comment will be created. Must be 'urn:li:share:{id}', 'urn:li:ugcPost:{id}', or 'urn:li:comment:({parentUrn},{commentId})'. Activity URNs ('urn:li:activity:{id}') are NOT supported.

inputs.name: parent_comment
inputs.about: For nested comments (replies), the URN of the parent comment being replied to. Format: 'urn:li:comment:({parentUrn},{commentId})'. Leave empty for first-level comments on the post.

tools.name: Create a LinkedIn post
tools.description: Creates a new post on LinkedIn for the authenticated user or an organization they manage. Requires w_member_social scope for posting as a person, and w_organization_social scope for posting as an organization (with ADMINISTRATOR, DIRECT_SPONSORED_CONTENT_POSTER, or CONTENT_ADMIN role).

inputs.name: author
inputs.about: The URN of the LinkedIn member or organization creating the post. IMPORTANT: Replace placeholder text with actual ID values. For a person: use 'urn:li:person:<actual_person_id>' (e.g., 'urn:li:person:F6kGF1Uduq' or 'urn:li:person:123456789'). Requires w_member_social scope. For an organization: use

inputs.name: images
inputs.about: Array of images to upload and attach to the post. Each element is a Supports 1-20 images. For a single image, use a list with one element. LinkedIn will automatically use the appropriate content type (media for single image, multiImage for 2+ images).

inputs.name: container
inputs.about: Container entity URN for posting within a specific container (e.g., 'urn:li:group:123456' for group posts). Use this field when posting to a group or other container entity.

inputs.name: commentary
inputs.about: The main text content of the post. This field supports plain text and @-mentions (e.g., @[LinkedIn Member](urn:li:person:xxxx)). Maximum length: 3000 characters.

inputs.name: visibility
inputs.about: Controls who can see the post. 'PUBLIC' makes it visible to everyone, 'CONNECTIONS' to connections only, 'LOGGED_IN' to signed-in LinkedIn members, and 'CONTAINER' for specific group/event posts.

inputs.name: distribution
inputs.about: Specifies distribution rules for the post, including feed distribution and targeting.

inputs.name: lifecycleState
inputs.about: The state of the post. Use 'PUBLISHED' to post directly, 'DRAFT' to save as a draft, or 'PUBLISH_REQUESTED' if the post requires review before publishing.

inputs.name: reshareContext
inputs.about: Context for resharing another post.

inputs.name: contentLandingPage
inputs.about: URL of the landing page that opens when the call-to-action button is clicked. Optional even when contentCallToActionLabel is set.

inputs.name: contentCallToActionLabel
inputs.about: Call-to-action button labels for posts.

inputs.name: isReshareDisabledByAuthor
inputs.about: Set to true to prevent others from resharing this post.

tools.name: Create video post
tools.description: Publish an available member-owned LinkedIn video as a personal native video post.

inputs.name: title
inputs.about: Optional title displayed with the video.

inputs.name: video_urn
inputs.about: URN of an uploaded LinkedIn video that is ready to publish.

inputs.name: commentary
inputs.about: Text to publish with the video. LinkedIn mentions and hashtags may use Little Text Format.

inputs.name: visibility
inputs.about: Who can see the personal video post: everyone, the member's connections, or signed-in LinkedIn members.

tools.name: Delete Comment
tools.description: Permanently delete a LinkedIn comment (irreversible) using its post URN and comment ID. For organization comments pass actor.

inputs.name: actor
inputs.about: The organization URN deleting the comment on its behalf. Required only for organization comments; omit it when deleting as the authenticated member.

inputs.name: comment_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the LinkedIn comment to delete.

inputs.name: entity_urn
inputs.about: The URN of the post containing the comment, such as a share or UGC post URN. The URN is URL-encoded automatically.

tools.name: Delete LinkedIn Post
tools.description: Deletes a specific LinkedIn post (share) by its unique `share_id`, which must correspond to an existing share.

inputs.name: share_id
inputs.about: Unique identifier of the LinkedIn share (post) to be deleted. Accepts either numeric ID (e.g., '7245341016004718592') or URN format (e.g., 'urn:li:share:7245341016004718592').

tools.name: Delete Post
tools.description: Delete a LinkedIn post using the Posts API REST endpoint. Supports both ugcPost and share URN formats. This action is idempotent - deleting an already-deleted post returns success. Note: LinkedIn's own live /rest/posts DELETE endpoint does NOT actually honor this on its own (a repeat delete 404s rather than returning 204 as LinkedIn's docs claim); this action compensates by treating a 404 as a successful deletion.

inputs.name: post_urn
inputs.about: The URN of the post to delete. Accepts either ugcPost or share URN formats (e.g., 'urn:li:ugcPost:7890123456' or 'urn:li:share:7245341016004718592'). The URN will be URL-encoded automatically.

tools.name: Delete UGC Post (Legacy)
tools.description: Delete a UGC post using the legacy UGC Post API endpoint. Use when you need to delete a post using the v2/ugcPosts endpoint. Deletion is idempotent - previously deleted posts also return success.

inputs.name: ugc_post_urn
inputs.about: The URN of the UGC post or share to delete. Format: 'urn:li:ugcPost:{id}' or 'urn:li:share:{id}'. Will be URL-encoded automatically by the action.

tools.name: Get ad targeting facets
tools.description: Tool to retrieve available ad targeting facets from LinkedIn Marketing API. Use when you need to discover what targeting options are available for ad campaigns (e.g., locations, industries, job functions).

tools.name: Get audience counts
tools.description: Retrieves audience size counts for specified targeting criteria. Use when estimating reach for LinkedIn ad campaigns or targeted content.

inputs.name: q
inputs.about: Query type parameter. Must be 'targetingCriteriaV2' for targeting criteria queries.

inputs.name: targetingCriteria
inputs.about: Targeting criteria with URL-encoded URNs. Format: (include:(and:List((or:(urn%3Ali%3AadTargetingFacet%3AFACET:List(urn%3Ali%3ATYPE%3AID)))))). IMPORTANT: Only the URN colons should be encoded as %3A, keep the structure syntax (parentheses, colons in 'and:' and 'or:') unencoded. Example for locations

tools.name: Get company info
tools.description: Retrieves details for the first organization in a page of ACLs matching the authenticated user's selected role and state. If no matching organizations are found, the tool returns an error.

inputs.name: role
inputs.about: The specific role to filter organization ACLs by.

inputs.name: count
inputs.about: The number of organization ACLs to return per page.

inputs.name: start
inputs.about: The starting index for pagination, representing the number of initial ACLs to skip.

inputs.name: state
inputs.about: The approval state of the role to filter by.

tools.name: Get group definition
tools.description: Retrieve a LinkedIn group's metadata by ID using approved-partner access.

inputs.name: group_id
inputs.about: The positive numeric identifier of the LinkedIn group.

tools.name: Get image details
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a LinkedIn image using its URN. Use when you need to check image status, get download URLs, or access image metadata for a single image.

inputs.name: image_urn
inputs.about: The image URN identifier. Can be provided as 'urn:li:image:XXX' or just the ID 'XXX'. The URN will be URL-encoded automatically when making the API request.

tools.name: Get images
tools.description: Tool to retrieve image metadata including download URLs, status, and dimensions from LinkedIn's Images API. Use when you need to access image details for posts, profiles, or media library assets.

inputs.name: ids
inputs.about: List of image URNs to retrieve. Each URN should be in the format 'urn:li:image:{ID}' (e.g., 'urn:li:image:C4E10AQFn10iWtKexVA'). Maximum recommended batch size depends on LinkedIn's API limits.

tools.name: Get my info
tools.description: Fetches the authenticated LinkedIn user's profile information including name, headline, profile picture, and other profile details.

tools.name: Get network size
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the follower count for a LinkedIn organization. Use when you need to get the number of members following a specific company or organization on LinkedIn.

inputs.name: edgeType
inputs.about: The type of network relationship to count. Use COMPANY_FOLLOWED_BY_MEMBER to get follower count.

inputs.name: organization_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier for the LinkedIn organization. This is the numeric ID from the organization URN (e.g., for 'urn:li:organization:3803', use '3803').

tools.name: Get organization page statistics
tools.description: Tool to retrieve page statistics for a LinkedIn organization page. Use when you need engagement metrics like page views and custom button clicks. Supports both lifetime statistics (all-time data segmented by demographics) and time-bound statistics (aggregate data for specific time ranges). Requires rw_organization_admin permission with ADMINISTRATOR role for the organization.

inputs.name: organization
inputs.about: Organization URN in format urn:li:organization:{id}. Example: urn:li:organization:2414183

inputs.name: timeRangeEnd
inputs.about: Inclusive ending timestamp in milliseconds since epoch. Only required for time-bound statistics. Omit for lifetime statistics.

inputs.name: timeRangeStart
inputs.about: Exclusive starting timestamp in milliseconds since epoch. Only required for time-bound statistics. Omit for lifetime statistics.

inputs.name: timeGranularityType
inputs.about: Granularity of the statistics. Use DAY for daily statistics or MONTH for monthly statistics. Only required for time-bound statistics. Omit for lifetime statistics.

tools.name: Get person profile
tools.description: Retrieves a LinkedIn member's profile information by their person ID. Returns lite profile fields (name, profile picture) by default, or basic profile fields (including headline and vanity name) with appropriate permissions.

inputs.name: person_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the LinkedIn member. Note: Each member id is unique to the context of your application only.

tools.name: Get post content
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed post content including text, images, videos, and metadata from LinkedIn by post URN. Use when you need to fetch the full content and details of a specific LinkedIn post.

inputs.name: post_id
inputs.about: Post URN identifier in the format 'urn:li:ugcPost:{id}' or 'urn:li:share:{id}'. Can also be URL-encoded. Example: 'urn:li:ugcPost:7428263313739988992'

tools.name: Get share statistics
tools.description: Retrieves share statistics for a LinkedIn organization, including impressions, clicks, likes, comments, and shares. Use to analyze content performance for an organization page. Optionally filter by time intervals to get time-bound statistics.

inputs.name: time_intervals
inputs.about: Time-bound statistics filter in RestLi 2.0 complex object format. Specify time range and granularity as: '(timeRange:(start:<start_timestamp>,end:<end_timestamp>),timeGranularityType:<GRANULARITY>)' where timestamps are in milliseconds since epoch and GRANULARITY is one of: DAY, WEEK, MONTH. Example

inputs.name: organizational_entity
inputs.about: The URN of the organization to retrieve share statistics for. Must be in the format 'urn:li:organization:<id>' where <id> is the organization ID (e.g., 'urn:li:organization:2414183'). Get organization IDs using the GET_COMPANY_INFO action.

tools.name: Get videos
tools.description: Retrieves video metadata from LinkedIn for a video owned by a person or organization. Supports single video retrieval and batch retrieval (multiple videos). Use when you need to get video details including duration, dimensions, status, download URLs, and media library information. Note: this does not support finding videos by a LinkedIn Ads sponsored account - that's an ads/Campaign-Manager-specific capability outside this toolkit's organic-posting scope.

inputs.name: video_ids
inputs.about: List of video URNs for batch retrieval (e.g., ['urn:li:video:C4D10AQE9WE5n4uJKUg', 'urn:li:video:C5F10AQElP1fVH1Ke6g']). Use this for batch retrieval. Mutually exclusive with 'video_urn'.

inputs.name: video_urn
inputs.about: Single video URN to retrieve (e.g., 'urn:li:video:C4E10AQGUkQY7trgh-Q'). Use this for single video retrieval. Mutually exclusive with 'video_ids'.

tools.name: Initialize document upload
tools.description: Initialize a LinkedIn document upload and return its upload URL and document URN.

inputs.name: owner
inputs.about: Owner URN (person or organization) that will own the uploaded document. Must be in the format 'urn:li:person:{id}' for personal posts or 'urn:li:organization:{id}' for organization posts. Use the GET_MY_INFO action to retrieve the person ID.

tools.name: Initialize image upload
tools.description: Tool to initialize an image upload to LinkedIn and return a presigned upload URL plus the resulting image URN. Use when you need to prepare an image upload for LinkedIn posts. After calling this tool, upload the image bytes to the returned upload_url via PUT request, then use the image URN in CREATE_LINKED_IN_POST action.

inputs.name: owner
inputs.about: Owner URN (person or organization) that will own the uploaded image. Must be in the format 'urn:li:person:{id}' for personal posts or 'urn:li:organization:{id}' for organization posts. Use the GET_MY_INFO action to retrieve the person ID.

tools.name: List reactions on entity
tools.description: Retrieves reactions (likes, celebrations, etc.) on a LinkedIn entity such as a share, post, or comment. Use when you need to see who reacted to content and what type of reactions were used.

inputs.name: sort
inputs.about: Sort order for reactions. CHRONOLOGICAL sorts by created date ascending, REVERSE_CHRONOLOGICAL sorts by created date descending (default), RELEVANCE sorts by relevance to the viewer.

inputs.name: count
inputs.about: Number of reactions to return per page.

inputs.name: start
inputs.about: Starting index for pagination (number of reactions to skip).

inputs.name: entity
inputs.about: The URN of the entity (share, post, or comment) to get reactions for. Format: 'urn:li:share:{id}', 'urn:li:ugcPost:{id}', 'urn:li:activity:{id}', or 'urn:li:comment:(activity:{activityId},{commentId})'. Do not URL-encode this value.

tools.name: Register image upload
tools.description: Tool to initialize a native LinkedIn image upload for feed shares and return a presigned upload URL plus the resulting digital media asset URN. Use when you need to upload an image to attach to a LinkedIn post. After calling this tool, upload the image bytes to the returned upload_url, then use the asset_urn in LINKEDIN_CREATE_LINKED_IN_POST.

inputs.name: recipe
inputs.about: The digital media recipe URN specifying the processing recipe for the image. Default is 'urn:li:digitalmediaRecipe:feedshare-image' for feed share images (works with a person or organization owner). Other recipes like 'companyUpdate-article-image' are for ads/campaign content and require an Ad Accou

inputs.name: owner_urn
inputs.about: URN of the owner entity that will own the uploaded image. Must be in the format 'urn:li:person:{id}' for personal posts or 'urn:li:organization:{id}' for organization posts. Use the GET_USER_INFO action to retrieve the person ID.

inputs.name: supported_upload_mechanism
inputs.about: Array of supported upload mechanisms. If not specified, LinkedIn will return the default mechanism (typically SYNCHRONOUS_UPLOAD).

tools.name: Search ad targeting entities
tools.description: Search for ad targeting entities using typeahead search. Use when you need to find targeting entities like geographic locations, job titles, industries, or other targeting criteria for LinkedIn ad campaigns.

inputs.name: count
inputs.about: Maximum number of results to return per page.

inputs.name: facet
inputs.about: Ad targeting facet URN to specify the entity type to search (e.g., 'urn:li:adTargetingFacet:locations' for geographic locations, 'urn:li:adTargetingFacet:titles' for job titles, 'urn:li:adTargetingFacet:industries' for industries).

inputs.name: query
inputs.about: Search query string to find targeting entities (e.g., 'united states', 'software engineer', 'technology').

inputs.name: start
inputs.about: Starting index for pagination, representing the number of initial results to skip.

inputs.name: queryVersion
inputs.about: Query version for the search request.

tools.name: Upload document
tools.description: Upload a PDF, DOC, DOCX, PPT, or PPTX document owned by the authenticated LinkedIn member and wait until it is available.

inputs.name: file
inputs.about:
A file the caller hands IN. ``s3key`` is an S3/R2 reference (production) or a
base64 ``data:`` URL (self-hosted ``FILE_BACKEND=base64``) — the ``FileStore`` knows
which. Mirrors ``mercury/tools/files.py`` field-for-field.

inputs.name: document_url
inputs.about: Public HTTP or HTTPS URL of a PDF, DOC, DOCX, PPT, or PPTX document. Provide this or file, but not both.

tools.name: Upload video
tools.description: Upload an MP4 video for a native post by the authenticated LinkedIn member and wait until it is ready.

inputs.name: file
inputs.about:
A file the caller hands IN. ``s3key`` is an S3/R2 reference (production) or a
base64 ``data:`` URL (self-hosted ``FILE_BACKEND=base64``) — the ``FileStore`` knows
which. Mirrors ``mercury/tools/files.py`` field-for-field.

inputs.name: video_url
inputs.about: Public HTTP or HTTPS URL of an MP4 video. Provide this or file, but not both.

tools.name: Who Am I
tools.description: Return the identity (name, email) of the connected LinkedIn account.
